Stripping these characters manually is incredibly tedious and prone to human error, particularly when formatting code strings, compiling data payloads, or prepping raw cryptographic hashes. Standard regex engines use patterns like backslash-s to target these characters globally, but applying these formulas in custom software setups requires manual scripting, posing significant barriers for non-technical users.
